label: Bible Study
prompt: And ye shall _____ them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verse: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
note: Faith as an all-day conversation — sitting, walking, lying down, getting up.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Continue in _____, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
verse: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
note: Paul's advice: keep praying, stay watchful, and season it all with thanksgiving.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with _____:
verse: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:
note: The plague of frogs reached ovens, beds, and kneading troughs — and Pharaoh, asked when they should go, said 'To morrow.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Ephraim is joined to _____: let him alone.
verse: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.
note: God's grim verdict on Ephraim's idolatry: leave him alone.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one _____ shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
verse: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
note: 'One jot or one tittle' — the smallest Hebrew letter and the tiniest pen-stroke. Not one will pass from the Law.
